# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and diagnostics** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates the engine to Skia m150 and expands filters and rendering diagnostics. It adds paint bounds for quick-reject culling, overdraw visualization, and image filter factories, while improving blur and surface-canvas performance. This release also removes deprecated notebook integration and turns remaining pre-v4 obsoletes into compile errors.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are compile errors** — Calls to the remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs now fail compilation, and SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality are absent from the reference assembly. Use the render-target constructors without sampleCount, run-buffer Glyphs and Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions instead. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **.NET Interactive integration removed** — The SkiaSharp NuGet package no longer embeds the deprecated SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive extension. Consumers that depend on its Polyglot Notebooks rendering support must remove that dependency or provide their own notebook integration. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — Moves the bundled rendering engine from Skia m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146))

## API Surface

- **Fast paint bounds enable quick-reject culling** — SKPaint.GetFastBounds() computes conservative paint bounds that include path effects, strokes, mask filters, and image filters, making it safe to pair with SKCanvas.QuickReject(). ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))
- **Overdraw visualization is complete** — SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() maps SKOverdrawCanvas draw counts through a six-color heat-map palette for rendering diagnostics. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))
- **Image filter composition gains crop and empty nodes** — SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() restricts filter output with configurable tile modes, while CreateEmpty() supplies an explicit transparent-black node that discards its input. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small raster blurs recover their fast path** — Routes small-sigma 8888 image blurs away from the slow raster-pipeline Gaussian path across supported native builds. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))
- **Apple typeface stream access is synchronized** — Updates the m150 engine with the upstream fix for concurrent CoreText typeface stream access on Apple platforms. ([#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Surface canvas access is faster** — SKSurface caches and reuses its SKCanvas wrapper across calls, and obtains a fresh wrapper if the surface-owned canvas wrapper was explicitly disposed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz from 14.2.0 to 14.2.1, with shaping, COLR v1, glyph-extents, and subsetting fixes.
